meaning: The same JoinRival jointly satisfies strong supplementation and every nonempty-family Sum1, while its top join of a,b contains a third disjoint atom and no Sum2 of a,b exists. Its missing top-minus-atom exact remainder refutes complementation. AtomPair jointly satisfies exact complementation but has no upper bound, hence neither Sum1 nor Sum2, for its pair. Both orders lack a null object. The all-family assertion is proved for arbitrary Sets, not merely sample families. This does not certify actual physical or metaphysical possibilities.
